title: GamePatchKit release manifest
description: Canonical JSON artifact generated by the Packager; never hand-authored. files[] fully and exactly represents the final logical file state of the release (added/changed/deleted history lives only in a separate build report, never here). manifestHash is the SHA-256 of these exact canonical bytes with no manifestHash field present, so this schema intentionally never defines a manifestHash property. Reference integrity (group/artifact/bundle-entry existence, part contiguity, content-addressed path reconstruction) and canonical array ordering are Core semantic validation (ManifestValidator), not expressed by this schema.

dataVersion.description: 'v1-' followed by the lowercase hex64 SHA-256 of the canonical identity bytes (packageId, group logical policy, and each file's normalized path/group/size/fileHash). Excludes artifact kind, bundle boundaries, compression, artifact paths/parts, compactVersion, and manifestHash. The 'v1-' prefix distinguishes dataVersion from the bare-hex manifestHash/fileHash/artifactHash family so the two are never confused at a glance.

compactVersion.description: Physical packaging generation. 0 for the initial package; inherited by incremental packages; incremented only when a compact changes physical artifact layout. Excluded from dataVersion.

groups.description: Canonical order: group name, ascending ordinal UTF-8 byte order.

artifacts.description: Canonical order: content-addressed artifact path, ascending ordinal UTF-8 byte order.

files.description: Canonical order: normalized relative path, ascending ordinal UTF-8 byte order. Represents the complete final file state; deleted files are simply absent.

normalizedRelativePath.description: Core-normalized relative path: '/' separators, NFC form, no absolute path, empty segment, '.', '..', backslash, or NUL. Exact grammar and canonical-form-already-applied checks are enforced by Core, not by this pattern.

compressionMetadata.description: Describes the actual payload format of one artifact. Independent per artifact: two artifacts in the same release and group may carry different compression metadata.

index.description: 0-based; parts[] must be contiguous starting at 0 (Core semantic validation).

size.description: Total size of the complete (pre-split) payload; must equal the sum of parts[].size. This is the physical payload size (post-compression, if compressed), not necessarily files[].size.

artifactHash.description: Hash of the complete (pre-split) payload, not any single part.

path.description: Full normalized relative path of the file as recorded inside the bundle archive. size/fileHash are not duplicated here; they are already recorded once on the corresponding files[] entry.

group.description: A bundle contains files from exactly one group.

artifactHash.description: SHA-256 of the bundle payload bytes; also referred to as bundleHash.

entries.description: Canonical order: normalized entry path, ascending ordinal UTF-8 byte order.

artifactHash.description: Must reference an artifacts[] entry with kind=file.
Must reference an artifacts[] entry with kind=bundle.

entryPath.description: Must match one of that bundle's entries[].path.

group.description: Must reference a declared groups[] entry.

size.description: Original (pre-compression) byte size of the file.

fileHash.description: SHA-256 of the original file bytes.
